summary.headline: Co-rising Stars in Inceptions
summary.text: Astrological effects of co-rising stars in inceptions and interrogations, including stellar temperaments, configurations with pivots, luminaries, the Lot of Fortune, Jupiter, and Mars, and indications of brilliance, authority, clerical renown, delay, and useful outcomes.
